item.title: Raydium collected 395% more fees than a month earlier
item.description: Raydium's fees rose 395% in the 30 days to 30 Sep 2026; the median of its 15 peer DEXs rose 15%. Source: DefiLlama, GitHub, CoinGecko.

item.title: Benqi Lending's health index: 50 out of 100, above the median of 28 peer lending protocols
item.description: Benqi Lending's health index was 50 out of 100 on 1 Oct 2026, place 13 of 28 among its sector peers; 4 of 5 measures were available. Seven days earlier it was 29. Source: DefiLlama, CoinGecko.

item.title: Uniswap handled 36% of DEX trading in the last 30 days, up from 26%
item.description: Uniswap had 36% of 30-day trading volume among 15 peer DEXs on 30 Sep 2026, against 26% thirty days earlier. Source: DefiLlama.

item.title: Aerodrome Slipstream fees “up 200%” in a month? One day did it.
item.description: The public series shows $8.08M of fees for Aerodrome Slipstream on 9 Sep, 33 times the median of the 14 days around it ($248.1K). With that day the 30-day change to 29 Sep 2026 is +200%; without it, +53%. Source: DefiLlama (daily fees), check by LV.

item.title: Uniswap V4: 10% of its 30-day fees came from one day
item.description: Among the ten protocols with the most fees in the 30 days to 29 Sep 2026, 1 had at least one one-off day (a day above 3 times the protocol's median day, or flagged by the data check); the lowest recurring share was 90% (Uniswap V4). Source: DefiLlama.
